# Fetch all playlists from both public and private in my playlist library
access_token = globals().get('access_token', None)
print('has_access_token:', access_token is not None)

def fetch_all_playlists(is_public):
    all_pl = []
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    while True:
        resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, is_public=is_public, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('is_public', is_public, 'page_index', page_index, 'returned', len(resp))
        if not resp:
            break
        all_pl.extend(resp)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index > 50:
            break
    return all_pl

public_playlists = fetch_all_playlists(True)
private_playlists = fetch_all_playlists(False)
print('total_public_playlists:', len(public_playlists))
print('total_private_playlists:', len(private_playlists))
print('public_titles_sample:', [p['title'] for p in public_playlists[:5]])
print('private_titles_sample:', [p['title'] for p in private_playlists[:5]])

all_playlists = public_playlists + private_playlists
# union unique song ids across all playlists
unique_song_ids = set()
for pl in all_playlists:
    unique_song_ids.update(pl.get('song_ids', []))
print('total_playlists_considered:', len(all_playlists))
print('unique_song_ids_count:', len(unique_song_ids))
print('some_unique_song_ids:', sorted(list(unique_song_ids))[:20])

# Build artist -> set of song_ids across all unique songs in playlists
from collections import defaultdict

unique_song_ids = sorted(list(unique_song_ids))
print('unique_song_ids:', len(unique_song_ids))

artist_to_songs = defaultdict(set)

# Iterate songs and collect artists
for i, sid in enumerate(unique_song_ids):
    song = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    artists = song.get('artists', [])
    artist_names = [a['name'] for a in artists]
    # add song to each artist
    for an in artist_names:
        artist_to_songs[an].add(sid)
    if (i+1) % 20 == 0:
        print('processed', i+1, 'songs; current artists count:', len(artist_to_songs))

print('total_artists_found:', len(artist_to_songs))
# compute counts
artist_counts = [(an, len(sids)) for an, sids in artist_to_songs.items()]
artist_counts_sorted = sorted(artist_counts, key=lambda x: (x[1], x[0].lower()))
print('top 10 least by (count,name):', artist_counts_sorted[:10])
print('min_count:', artist_counts_sorted[0][1])

least_artists = artist_counts_sorted[:4]
print('least_artists:', least_artists)
